description: Hitzebetroffenheit is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by klimaatlas-bw.de. Data set on the municipal heat impact in Baden-Württemberg based on the planning information map heat and land use and population data. For each municipality, the proportion of heat exposure is determined for the total area and population, as well as for certain land uses and population groups for different temporal conditions. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heat Affliction" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Betroffenheit, ENVI. The listing shows 2025-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
